bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Knowledge-practice forms use MCQ/MR only; official item formats not reproducible in this format are listed in the exam-version record.

items.stem: Which document type is mandatory and specifies exact, measurable requirements an organisation must follow?

options.rationale: Correct: standards are mandatory and specify precise requirements.
A procedure gives step-by-step instructions, not the overarching requirement.
A baseline is a minimum configuration reference, derived from standards.

items.explanation: Standards are the mandatory, measurable layer beneath policy.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: A CISO must prioritise risk treatment. A risk has low likelihood but catastrophic impact and no feasible control. Which treatment is most appropriate?

options.text: Transfer the risk, for example through insurance
options.rationale: Correct: when a severe risk cannot be reduced cost-effectively, transfer shares the financial impact.
Silent acceptance of a catastrophic risk without a decision record is poor governance.

options.text: Ignore it because likelihood is low
options.rationale: Low likelihood with catastrophic impact still demands treatment.

options.text: Mitigate with a control that does not exist yet
options.rationale: No feasible control exists, so mitigation is not currently available.

items.explanation: With no feasible mitigation, transferring the financial impact is the sound choice.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: Which TWO are core principles of secure design?

options.rationale: Correct: layered controls reduce reliance on any single defence.
Correct: granting minimal access limits blast radius.

options.text: Security through obscurity as the sole control
options.rationale: Hiding details is not a reliable standalone control.
Logging is essential to detection and accountability.

items.explanation: Defence in depth and least privilege are foundational secure-design principles.
